data.change_summary: Added an artifact-safe habitat/geometry probe suite flow: the habitat/geometry tests now funnel mechanistic comparisons through recorded harness failures instead of raw `assert!`, the biofilter probe was rebuilt around a media-limited custom state that checks larger media for higher carrying capacity, lower reduced-nitrogen burden, and earlier clearance, and `all_habitat_geometry_probes_summary` now runs all five probes together, prints a readable pass/fail report, and fails non-zero on violations. I also added `HarnessRun::record_failure` coverage so custom probe failures still emit the usual harness artifacts before the test returns an error.
outstanding_risks: Unexpected panics inside a probe before `finish_probe` still depend on the summary runner's panic reporting; the guaranteed artifact path now covers the intended assertion/failure checks but not arbitrary panics.

The strengthened biofilter probe asserts lower combined TAN+NO2 burden and earlier reduced-nitrogen clearance rather than a lower standalone nitrite peak, because the larger-media run currently clears ammonia faster while briefly allowing a higher NO2 crest.

steps.description: Added harness support for recording custom failures and verified the finish path still surfaces artifact-backed failure output.
Refactored the five habitat/geometry probes to use reusable probe runners plus recorded failure checks so mechanistic failures no longer bypass `finish()` artifact emission.

Strengthened the biofilter scaling probe with a custom media-limited setup that checks habitat area, carrying capacity, reduced-nitrogen exposure, nitrifier biomass, and earlier clearance for the larger filter.
Added the aggregate habitat/geometry summary test and revalidated the full `tank_harness` package after formatting.

validation_evidence: `cargo test -p tank_harness --lib -- --nocapture` passed: 5 unit tests green, including the new recorded-failure harness coverage.
`cargo test -p tank_harness --test e2e_habitat_geometry_probes -- --nocapture` passed: 6 tests green, including `all_habitat_geometry_probes_summary` with 5/5 probes passing.
`cargo test -p tank_harness` passed for the full package: 37 tests passed, 0 failed, 1 doc-test ignored.
